title: Tap Rush
blurb: Most taps in ten seconds takes the pot.

verifier.instructions: Use only the log's entries with src "box": its taps, with t "tap", and its one end, with t "end". Ignore every entry with src "game": a game can claim anything. If the end's why is "lost", the verdict is cannot_judge. The clock starts at the earliest tap's at. If there are taps and the end's at is less than 10000 ms after the clock, the race was cut short and the verdict is cannot_judge. A tap counts only if its at is less than 10000 ms after the clock. Count each seat's taps. The pot is the header's amount times the number of players, in base units. The seat with the most taps gets the whole pot and the others get 0. If seats tie for the most, split the pot evenly between them in whole base units, give any remainder one unit at a time to the tied seats from the lowest seat up, and give the others 0. A match with no taps is a tie between every seat.
